shots.visual: A heavy rusty iron door is kicked violently open with sparks flying. A stern man in a dark jacket steps through dust and smoke under harsh dramatic lighting.
A sharp-suited villain holding a wine glass flinches in surprise as dust settles around him.
A capable woman tied firmly to a metal chair with thick ropes, bruised cheek, looking up with wide, shocked eyes.
Close up of a man's face, dark cold eyes filled with intense murderous intent, stepping forward slowly.
The villain bursts into a sinister laugh, throwing his glass to the floor where it shatters into pieces.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 陳峰！你還真敢一個人來送死！

shots.visual: A dozen armed thugs wearing leather jackets emerge from the gloom, surrounding the solitary hero.
The villain points aggressively forward with a cruel, ruthless smirk.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 給我廢了他！留一口氣就行！

shots.visual: Fast action sequence: the protagonist dodges a heavy swinging pipe, grabs the attacker's wrist, and twists it backward forcefully.
Close up of an attacker screaming in agony as his weapon drops onto the dusty concrete ground.
Low angle shot: the protagonist executes a powerful spin kick, sending two guards flying backwards into wooden crates.
The villain's arrogant expression instantly vanishes, replaced by utter shock and rage.
A massive, muscular lead henchman charges forward holding a heavy iron club with both hands.
The protagonist ducks under the crushing blow effortlessly, closing the distance into the brute's chest.
High-impact close up: the protagonist kicks fiercely into the brute's knee joint, snapping it backward.
The giant henchman collapses groaning in agony, as the protagonist steps over him without looking back.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 就憑這群雜碎，也想擋我？

shots.visual: The tied woman watches in awe and relief as the remaining guards back away in terror.
The protagonist crouches down, draws a sharp blade, and slices through the ropes holding the woman.
The woman tears off tape from her face, catching her breath while looking anxiously past the hero.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 陳總！別管我，小心趙天豪！

shots.visual: The villain frantically draws a dark handgun from his suit jacket, hands trembling slightly.
Close up of the villain aiming the barrel forward with madness and desperation.
In a split second, the protagonist lunges, grabs the handgun barrel, and wrenches it out of the villain's hand.
The villain's wrist is twisted back violently, his mouth open wide in a silent scream of pain.
Tense showdown: the protagonist slams the villain hard against a concrete pillar, pressing the gun muzzle straight onto his forehead.
Cold sweat drips down the villain's face as he trembles violently with frantic fear.
The protagonist's face remains totally calm and deadly, his finger beginning to pull the trigger.
The woman stands near the pillar, watching the fatal standoff with held breath.
The villain grimaces hysterically, eyes bulging with desperate menace.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 你殺了我，你也別想活著離開！

shots.visual: Extreme close up of the handgun's hammer cocking all the way back, a millisecond from firing.
View from high catwalk shadows overlooking the scene, a silenced rifle barrel glinting in the dark.
A loud gunshot shatters the room. A sniper bullet detonates the concrete wall right beside the protagonist's head, dust exploding out into a frozen suspenseful frame.
